assumptions.gate_imported_from_request_10_5: finite shared phase/geometric projection is runtime-motivated; independent per-carrier complex projection collapses
assumptions.scope: named source-inspection audit only; no runtime

rows.implementation_evidence: The public release path contains Nutimo source and J0337 data products; this audit inspects the source path only.
rows.notes: Public source availability is imported as a setup fact. The runtime stack remains intentionally out of scope here.

rows.implementation_evidence: The core parameter map is a finite list of spin, inner-orbit, outer-orbit, mass, orientation, SEP, sky, and extra-body parameters rather than Fourier amplitudes per carrier.
rows.inferred_rank_class: finite parameter rank, not per-carrier complex
rows.notes: For the Omega_in, Omega_out, abs(Omega_in-Omega_out) bridge this supports the finite-manifold side of the 10.5 gate, pending actual fit configuration.

rows.implementation_evidence: Changes to orbital, SEP, and extra-body parameters set motion_changed and route through Compute_state_vectors.
rows.notes: Carrier amplitudes are generated by recomputed worldline and delay maps, not by independent complex coefficients at each frequency.

rows.implementation_evidence: Einstein, Shapiro, aberration, and geometric delay calls take the shared pulsar/companion state vectors sp, si, so and line-of-sight geometry as inputs.
rows.notes: This is the named-code analog of the phase/geometric-lock assumption used in the symbolic 10.5 gate.

rows.implementation_evidence: The geometric delay projects the pulsar state against the SSB-to-pulsar-system line of sight and optional Kopeikin/Shklovskii terms, with component delay details available.
rows.notes: The projection is parameterized by physical geometry; it is not written as carrier-local complex amplitude freedom.

rows.implementation_evidence: The gradient utility differentiates each residual with respect to the finite fitted parameter list and writes an ntoa by npar Jacobian.
rows.notes: A future runtime hand-off can test the exact rank class by adding a dynamic-chi column to this finite Jacobian.

rows.implementation_evidence: Residuals are computed from spin phase, spin derivatives, dphase0, turn counts, and an optional weighted mean removal.
rows.inferred_rank_class: absorbs secular or constant pieces only
rows.notes: This nuisance is expected and does not by itself supply independent complex freedom at the three carrier frequencies.

rows.implementation_evidence: The RN_PL branch introduces explicit sinusoid amplitudes and phases ds_Ak, ds_phik for multiple harmonics.
rows.inferred_rank_class: can reach per-carrier complex rank if enabled
rows.notes: Dynamic-chi tests must disable or explicitly isolate this special case; otherwise it can absorb carrier-level phase and amplitude relations by construction.

rows.implementation_evidence: The standard core is finite parameter/state/geometry based; the explicit harmonic special case is a separable collapse risk rather than the default projection form.
rows.inferred_rank_class: conditional finite shared rank; collapses if arbitrary harmonic nuisance is admitted on target carriers
rows.notes: The named source inspection is positive enough to justify an external runtime hand-off only for a configuration that keeps the finite geometric model and excludes per-harmonic carrier soak-up terms.
rows.projection_nuisance_class: hybrid but core is finite shared physical manifold
rows.source_anchor: Combined Parameters.h, Parameters.cpp, Fittriple-compute.cpp, Delay_brut.cpp, Compute_gradients.cpp inspection

runtime_handoff_rule.not-runtime-motivated: Do not claim a dynamic-chi observable if arbitrary harmonic amplitude/phase nuisance is enabled on the target carriers.
runtime_handoff_rule.runtime-motivated: Use the standard integrated three-body finite-parameter core and test a dynamic-chi column against its Jacobian.

source_releases.local_source_scope: Nutimo 2025 source inspected from nutimo.tar.bz2; no build, runtime, TOA fit, or dependency provisioning was attempted.

verdict_summary.implementation_class: conditional positive: standard core is finite shared; arbitrary harmonic nuisance collapses the bridge if enabled
